root.label: FBI memorandum summarizes allegations about Salah Sarsour

events.label: FBI memorandum summarizes allegations about Salah Sarsour

slots.name: memorandum date
slots.sentence: A 2001 FBI memorandum summarized allegations from Sarsour’s brother, Jamil, that he had been involved in fundraising for the Holy Land Foundation, an organization shuttered by the federal government for terror ties, on behalf of Hamas.
